The '''Rydonnian Imperial Consulate''' was a [[Skyscraper/Legends|starscraper]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] building in [[Rydonni Prime]]'s [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Ryell]]. During a parade, a runaway [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] rammed the building, shattering every [[transplastoid]] panel on the building's first thirteen floors.<ref name="Easy">{{JournalCite|9|Easy Credits}}</ref>
